$comment: Generated by scripts/ExtractProps.mjs from the TypeScript source of the public entry points; do not edit. Run npm run docs:props after changing a public component.

ActionGroup.description: Wrapped actions use a 1 rem gap; stacked actions use 0.5 rem and fill the group.

Alert.description: An inline banner for a page- or section-level message, in its tone.

props.name: tone
props.description: info (default), success, warning or error; each has its tone color and default icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the tone's icon; false shows none.

props.name: action
props.description: An action below the message, such as a Button or Link.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a dismiss button that calls it; the application removes the alert.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button; Dismiss by default.

props.name: announce
props.description: The alert appeared because of something that just happened and should interrupt: warning and error alerts take the alert role. Info and success alerts are always polite status messages.

AnimatedNumber.description: A number within text that rolls to its new value when it changes: up when it grows and down when it shrinks, so a count updated by other controls is noticed. The text is always the current value.

props.name: format
props.description: Text for the value; the locale's number format by default.

AppShell.description: Application frame with a topbar and a collapsible navigation sidebar. Collapsed sidebars expand while hovered or focused, the brand mark turns into the toggle on hover, and narrow viewports open the sidebar as an overlay that closes after navigation.

props.name: navigation
props.description: NavList.Item elements for the sidebar.

props.name: navigationLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the sidebar navigation.

props.name: children
props.description: Page content.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading bar along the bottom of the topbar, for example while the next page loads.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the loading bar.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Persist the collapsed preference under this localStorage key.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Controlled collapsed preference on wide viewports.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Labels for the sidebar toggle.

props.name: sidebarContent
props.description: Content below the navigation, such as a Tree. It fills the remaining sidebar height and scrolls itself; hidden while the sidebar shows icons only.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Let people adjust the expanded sidebar width by dragging its edge or with the arrow keys.

props.name: sidebarWidth
props.description: Controlled expanded width in pixels while resizable.

props.name: onSidebarWidthChange
props.description: Called with the new width in pixels while the sidebar is resized.

props.name: sidebarMinWidth
props.description: Smallest resizable width in pixels; 12 rem by default.

props.name: sidebarMaxWidth
props.description: Largest resizable width in pixels; 32 rem by default.

props.name: resizeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the resize handle.

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand mark in the sidebar toggle; the toggle icon replaces it while the sidebar region is hovered.

props.name: context
props.description: Content in the topbar beside the toggle, such as an organization switcher. In the split topbar it sits above the sidebar and hides while the sidebar is compact.

props.name: title
props.description: Current page name in the topbar. Hidden on narrow viewports.

props.name: actions
props.description: Topbar actions at the end, such as a ThemeToggle and an account Menu.

props.name: dividers
props.description: Separator lines between the topbar, sidebar and content (default).

props.name: topbar
props.description: split (default): the context sits above the sidebar, as wide as the sidebar, beside the page part. full: one row across the window, independent of the sidebar: the toggle, the context at its natural width, the title, and the actions at the end.

props.name: titleBar
props.description: The topbar is the window's title bar, for installed web apps and desktop shells that draw their own title bar (the Window Controls Overlay): empty space drags the window, it leaves room for the window controls the system draws, and the controls inside are compact. The shell then fills the window and its content area scrolls below the title bar instead of the document; the keyboard scrolls it as it would the document. Meant for the full topbar.

AppShellSkeleton.description: The AppShell frame with placeholders, for the first load before account data is available.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible loading announcement.

props.name: navigationItems
props.description: Number of navigation placeholders. Defaults to 3.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Match the stored collapsed preference of the AppShell it precedes.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Match a resizable AppShell's stored width and bounds.

props.name: children
props.description: Placeholder for the page content.

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand mark in the sidebar toggle; the toggle icon replaces it while the sidebar region is hovered.

props.name: dividers
props.description: Separator lines between the topbar, sidebar and content (default).

props.name: topbar
props.description: split (default): the context sits above the sidebar, as wide as the sidebar, beside the page part. full: one row across the window, independent of the sidebar: the toggle, the context at its natural width, the title, and the actions at the end.

props.name: titleBar
props.description: The topbar is the window's title bar, for installed web apps and desktop shells that draw their own title bar (the Window Controls Overlay): empty space drags the window, it leaves room for the window controls the system draws, and the controls inside are compact. The shell then fills the window and its content area scrolls below the title bar instead of the document; the keyboard scrolls it as it would the document. Meant for the full topbar.

Avatar.description: A round picture of a person or organization, with the default person picture or initials as fallback.

props.name: name
props.description: Person or organization name; the accessible name with label, and the initials fallback.

props.name: src
props.description: Picture URL. The fallback shows while it loads and when it is missing or fails.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown without a picture: the default person picture, or initials (for example, for an organization).

props.name: size
props.description: small 1.5 rem, standard 2 rem (default), large 3 rem, display 5.5 rem.

props.name: label
props.description: Announce the name; omit when adjacent text already names the person.

AvatarButton.description: A person's avatar as a button, typically the account menu trigger in a topbar. A halo shows hover, press and an open menu, and the tooltip names the account.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name: shown in the tooltip, and the accessible name unless aria-label is set.

props.name: detail
props.description: A second tooltip line, such as the e-mail address of the signed-in account.

props.name: src
props.description: Picture URL; the default person picture shows without one.

props.name: size
props.description: small 1.5 rem, standard 2 rem (default) or large 3 rem picture, inside a slightly larger hit area.

AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping avatars for a set of people, such as the members of a project, with a chip that counts the rest and lists them in its tooltip. A ring in the color of the surface below separates the avatars.

props.name: people
props.description: The people, in order. Pass a preview with total when there are many more.

props.name: max
props.description: The most avatars to show; the overflow chip after them counts the rest. All by default.

props.name: size
props.description: As Avatar: small 1.5 rem, standard 2 rem (default), large 3 rem or display 5.5 rem.

props.name: total
props.description: How many people there are in all, when people is only a preview of them.

props.name: onPersonClick
props.description: Makes every avatar a button with a name tooltip; receives the person pressed.

props.name: formatMore
props.description: Text for people beyond the list, in the overflow tooltip and the group's name; "N more".

props.name: formatLabel
props.description: The group's name from the number of people and their names, which end with formatMore's text for people counted in total but not listed: "3 people: Alex Morgan, Sam Lee, 1 more" by default. aria-label replaces it.

Badge.description: A small pill label for a state, such as In progress, Blocked or Archived, or a short name.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning of the state; done is the purple of completed work. Neutral by default.

props.name: variant
props.description: subtle (default) tints the background, solid fills it with the tone, outline draws a border.

BrandLogo.description: Official envsemble lockup, sized relative to the surrounding text.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for a meaningful standalone icon. Omit for decoration.

Breadcrumbs.description: The path from the top level to the current page; earlier levels are links.

props.name: items
props.description: From the top level to the current page, which is last.

props.name: wrap
props.description: The trail wraps onto more lines when it runs out of room; true by default. False keeps it on one line, for a bar or header: the current page is cut short first, and earlier levels keep their width.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation; Breadcrumb by default.

Button.description: Starts an action, or goes to a destination with href, in one of seven emphases, with optional icons; icon-only with iconOnly. It renders a native button or link.

props.name: variant
props.description: The emphasis: primary for the main action of a view, important for a rare consequential one, secondary and outlined for the rest, destructive for an action that deletes or ends something, text for a link-like action and quiet for an application's chrome, such as a toolbar.

props.name: underline
props.description: Show an underline for the text variant; defaults to false.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as an Add icon.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A decorative icon after the label, such as a ChevronRight for a next step.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started by this button is running: a spinner replaces the content without changing the button's size, and the button reports busy and ignores activation until pending ends.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled button cannot be pressed; a disabled link has no destination, cannot be focused or followed, and reports aria-disabled.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The action's name, such as Delete draft, for an icon-only button.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination: the element is a native link, through the LinkProvider's link component.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Show only icon, in a square button that keeps its size; name it with aria-label.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon of an icon-only button.

ButtonGroup.description: Connected buttons keep their own outer corners and share the row inner radius.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A row of buttons, or a column in which every button is as wide as the group.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the container's width, such as a sidebar's: in a row, labelled buttons share the room the icon-only ones leave, which keep their square size, and a row of icon-only buttons shares it evenly; in a column, every button is as wide as the group.

Calendar.description: A month of days to choose one from, following the WAI-ARIA date picker grid: the arrow keys move by day and week, Page Up and Page Down by month (with Shift, by year), Home and End to the week's ends, and Enter or Space chooses the day. Named with aria-label or aria-labelledby, it is a group around the month's grid.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen day as YYYY-MM-DD, or null for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the chosen day as YYYY-MM-DD.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be chosen, as YYYY-MM-DD; earlier days are unavailable.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day that can be chosen, as YYYY-MM-DD; later days are unavailable.

props.name: weekStart
props.description: The first day of each week, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday: by default the locale's, or Monday where the browser cannot tell.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the month and weekday names and the day numbers; the browser's by default. The days are always Gregorian, also in a locale with a calendar of its own.

props.name: previousMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous month button; Previous month by default.

props.name: nextMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next month button; Next month by default.

CalendarHeatmap.description: A calendar of daily values with weeks as columns and weekdays as rows, colored in steps of a tone. Each day names its date and value, shows them in a tooltip on hover and focus, and the grid is one tab stop that the arrow keys move through.

props.name: data
props.description: Values by day; days without an entry count as 0.

props.name: startDate
props.description: The first day shown, as YYYY-MM-DD; the earliest day in data by default.

props.name: endDate
props.description: The last day shown, as YYYY-MM-DD; the latest day in data by default.

props.name: levels
props.description: Color steps including the empty step, 2 to 10; 5 by default.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The value that takes the strongest color; the largest value shown by default.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: The lowest value of each color step above the empty one, in ascending order, such as quantiles of the data to color by rank. Up to nine; they replace levels and maxValue. A day below the first threshold shows as empty, and a first threshold of 0 or less colors days of 0 too.

props.name: weekStart
props.description: The first day of each week column: 0 for Sunday (default) or 1 for Monday.

props.name: tone
props.description: The tone the colors are mixed from: accent by default.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Text for a value; English digit grouping by default.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: Text for a day's date, in its accessible name and the default tooltip.

props.name: formatTooltip
props.description: Tooltip content for a day; the date and value by default.

props.name: monthLabels
props.description: Twelve month names above the weeks, from January; English abbreviations by default.

props.name: weekdayLabels
props.description: Seven weekday names beside the rows, from Sunday; English abbreviations by default.

props.name: lessLabel
props.description: Legend text before the lightest color; Less by default.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Legend text after the strongest color; More by default.

Card.description: Shared card surface, optionally a native action or a content card with an action strip.

props.name: padding
props.description: Omit for responsive padding; 0 removes padding.

props.name: layout
props.description: An action strip implies action layout; explicit layout also works without actions.

ClickableCard.description: A single interactive surface. Do not nest links or controls inside it.

Code.description: Inline source in the code theme of the app theme; use CodeBlock for multiline source.

CodeBlock.description: Source display in the code theme of the app theme, with that code theme's own colors; copy always uses the original string.

CodeDiff.description: The changes between two versions of a file, rendered by Diffs (diffs.com) in its own Pierre theme for the app theme, as code blocks are; the whole file when nothing changed.

props.name: before
props.description: The source before the change.

props.name: after
props.description: The source after the change.

props.name: filename
props.description: Names the file in the header and chooses its language, such as form.json.

props.name: language
props.description: Overrides the language the file name implies, such as json.

props.name: header
props.description: Shows the file header with its name and change counts; true by default.

props.name: expandUnchanged
props.description: Shows the unchanged lines between changes instead of folding them; false by default.

props.name: layout
props.description: auto (default) sets old and new side by side from 56 rem of width; unified keeps one column.

ColorPicker.description: A labeled color area, hue slider and native HEX field; the application owns the result.

props.name: value
props.description: An opaque six-digit HEX color, with an optional # prefix.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives valid colors normalized to lowercase #rrggbb.

props.name: hint
props.default: 'Enter six hexadecimal digits, with an optional #.'
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: compact
props.description: Take the shared control height and a pill shape, to sit beside buttons in a toolbar. The label is hidden unless showLabel is set; it still names the field for assistive technology, and a placeholder gives the visible guidance.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Short, non-interactive text before the value, such as the start of an address. It is not part of the value; it shows once the field has focus or a value and is read after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: The field's look: outlined, with a thin border; plain, with no border or fill and an underline on hover and focus; or quiet, only its text and start icon at rest, with a soft fill under the pointer and while focused and a placeholder that clears on focus, for a search at the top of a sidebar or a list.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: A decorative icon at the start of the field, such as Search or Mail.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the hint.

props.name: endAction
props.description: A control at the end of the field, such as a text IconButton that reveals or copies the value; name it with aria-label.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label in the field, where it rests while the field is empty and floats into the outline while the field has focus or a value. Compact fields hide it unless this is set.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Short, non-interactive text after the value, such as a unit. It is not part of the value; it shows once the field has focus or a value and is read after the label.

ColorSwatch.description: A round sample of a color with a hairline ring, so light and dark colors stay visible on every surface. It is decorative: name the color in the text beside it. As a Button's icon it takes the icon's size, such as on a button that opens a ColorPicker.

props.name: color
props.description: The color it shows, such as #6750a4.

Combobox.description: A text field that filters a list of options as people type, for choosing one option or several. Chosen options show as removable chips; keyboard, focus and announcements follow the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern.

props.name: items
props.description: The options, or groups of options under headings, in display order.

props.name: filter
props.description: Which options match the typed text: by default those whose label or description contains it, ignoring case and accents. null shows the items as given, for searching on the server.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Receives the typed text, and an empty string once it is cleared, such as to search a server.

props.name: loading
props.description: The options are loading: the popup shows loadingLabel instead of emptyLabel.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Shown in the popup while loading; Loading… by default.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown in the popup when no option matches; No matches by default.

props.name: density
props.description: standard (default) is the text field of forms; compact takes the compact control height, like a compact Select, and the compact menu's popup.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label inside the field, where it floats into the outline while the field has focus or a value. Defaults to true, and to false for compact fields, which can use a placeholder instead.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear button removes the value while there is one; Esc on the closed field clears it too.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button; Clear by default.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a chip's remove button; Remove followed by the label by default.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called as the popup opens and closes, such as to load the options as it opens.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the default filter's matching; the browser's by default.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, such as Project name; it also names the control for assistive technology.

props.name: hint
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the hint.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Several options can be chosen; they show as chips in the field.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen option's value, or null for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((value: string | null, item: Item | null) => void) | ((value: string[], items: Item[]) => void)
props.description: Receives the chosen value and its option, or null twice once the field is cleared.

CommandPalette.description: A quick-open dialog near the top of the window: a search field over a list of options the application filters and ranks. The keyboard moves the highlight while typing continues.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog, the search field and the list.

props.name: items
props.description: Filtered and ranked by the application, in display order.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Enter or click; Ctrl or Cmd sets modifier.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close after an item is selected; true by default.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when there are no items.

props.name: hints
props.description: Key hints below the list, such as { keys: ['Enter'], label: 'Open' }.

props.name: footer
props.description: Other content below the list, after the hints.

Composer.description: The message field of a conversation: a multiline field on a raised surface that grows with its text up to maxRows, with a send button at the end that becomes a stop button while running. Enter submits, Shift+Enter starts a new line and an input method's composition never submits. Without onSubmit, Enter and the send button submit the field's form.

props.name: value
props.description: The message text of a controlled composer.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting text of an uncontrolled composer; it clears after each submit through onSubmit and when its form resets.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the text as it changes, and an empty string when an uncontrolled composer clears.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Enter or the send button submits the text as typed, and an uncontrolled composer clears. Blank text never submits, and neither does a disabled, running or pending composer. Without onSubmit, they submit the field's form instead and the text stays until the form resets. Without onSubmit or a form there is nothing to send: the button is unavailable and Enter starts a new line.

props.name: pending
props.description: A send is in progress, such as a request the application makes: sending is unavailable while the field stays editable and keeps focus. The pending action of an enclosing form counts too; set pending for a form the field joins through its form attribute, or for a request of the application's own.

props.name: running
props.description: A reply is on its way: the send button becomes a stop button and Enter does not submit.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called by the stop button while running; it stays available when the field is disabled.

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the send button; Send by default.

props.name: stopLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the stop button; Stop by default.

props.name: minRows
props.description: Lines the field shows while empty; 1 by default.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Lines the field grows to before it scrolls; 8 by default.

props.name: start
props.description: Content at the start of the action row, such as an attach button or the name of a model.

props.name: footer
props.description: Supporting text below the composer, such as a note on attachments; it describes the field.

ConfirmButton.description: A button for an action that takes effect at once and cannot be undone. The first press arms it and names the consequence in place; a second press runs it. It disarms after a few seconds, when focus leaves and on Escape.

props.name: variant
props.description: The resting appearance; armed, the button is always destructive. outlined by default, and secondary for an icon-only button, like IconButton; quiet for an action in the application's chrome, such as a toolbar.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The label while armed, naming what a second press does, such as “Remove Morgan?”.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs on the second press, while the button is armed.

props.name: armedDuration
props.description: How long the button stays armed without a second press, in milliseconds.

props.name: underline
props.description: Show an underline for the text variant; defaults to false.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as an Add icon.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A decorative icon after the label, such as a ChevronRight for a next step.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started by this button is running: a spinner replaces the content without changing the button's size, and the button reports busy and ignores activation until pending ends.

props.name: icon
props.description: A round icon-only button at rest, named by aria-label. Armed, it shows the icon with the confirm label, so the consequence is still named.

ContextMenu.description: Actions for an area, opened by right click, long press, the ContextMenu key or Shift+F10.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu, such as Document actions.

props.name: content
props.description: Menu content: Menu.Item, Menu.Group, Menu.Separator and the other menu parts. A function receives the element the menu was opened on: the deepest element under the pointer, or the focused element (its active descendant, when it has one) for the keyboard.

props.name: children
props.description: One element that becomes the region; it must accept native props and a ref.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The region keeps the browser's own context menu.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility, for example to open the menu from another control.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new visibility as the menu opens or closes.

props.name: anchorPoint
props.description: Viewport point to open at while controlled; otherwise the menu opens at the pointer.

props.name: density
props.description: compact suits dense surfaces such as a compact Tree; see Menu.Root.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the menu popup.

CopyButton.description: Copies text to the clipboard. Icon-only by default, with its name in a tooltip, or a labelled button with children. After a press the icon becomes a check, and Copied shows in the tooltip and is announced for two seconds, or Couldn’t copy when the clipboard refuses.

props.name: value
props.description: The text to copy, or a function that returns it, also as a promise, when pressed.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Runs once the text is on the clipboard, with that text.

props.name: variant
props.description: As Button; secondary by default.

props.name: size
props.description: standard (default) takes the surrounding density; compact is the 2 rem compact size anywhere.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon at rest, ContentCopy by default; a check replaces it once the text is copied.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Shown in the tooltip and announced after copying; Copied by default.

props.name: failedLabel
props.description: Shown in the tooltip and announced when nothing could be copied; Couldn’t copy by default.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: The button's name, also in an icon-only button's tooltip, where it has none of its own: no aria-label or aria-labelledby, and a label without words, such as an empty string; Copy by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Without children, or with children that render nothing, the button is icon-only, named by aria-label, such as Copy link; a blank one leaves it named by copyLabel.

CounterBadge.description: A compact rounded count, for example beside a navigation label or a menu item.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Full meaning for assistive technology, such as "12 unread"; the number alone otherwise.

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral (default) is a quiet fill; accent draws attention.

DatePicker.description: A field for a date, or a date and time, that shows the value in the reader's locale and opens a calendar to choose it, with keyboard access following the WAI-ARIA date picker.

props.name: value
props.description: The value: a day as YYYY-MM-DD, or with withTime a local date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm. null, or an empty string, for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the new value, or null once the field is cleared.

props.name: withTime
props.description: Choose a time as well: the value becomes YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest value, as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm; earlier days are unavailable.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest value, as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm; later days are unavailable.

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: The time a newly chosen day starts with, as HH:mm; 00:00 by default.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the shown value and the calendar's names and numbers; the browser's by default. Dates are Gregorian, also in a locale with a calendar of its own.

props.name: weekStart
props.description: The calendar's first day of the week, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday; see Calendar.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How the field shows the value: Intl.DateTimeFormat options, by default the medium date style and, with withTime, the short time style, in the Gregorian calendar unless they name another.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value can be read and focused but not changed.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty and its label floats or is hidden.

props.name: density
props.description: standard (default) is the text field of forms; compact takes the compact control height.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label inside the field, where it floats into the outline while the field has a value, focus or its calendar open. Defaults to true, and to false for compact fields.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear button in the field and in the calendar removes the value.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the field's clear button and text of the calendar's; Clear by default.

props.name: todayLabel
props.description: The calendar's shortcut to today; Today by default.

props.name: nowLabel
props.description: With withTime, the calendar's shortcut to the current date and time; Now by default.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: With withTime, the button that closes the calendar; Done by default.

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: With withTime, the label of the time field; Time by default.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, such as Project name; it also names the control for assistive technology.

props.name: hint
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the hint.

Dialog.description: A focused task over the page: a centered modal, a modal near the top of the window, or a full-height side panel at the right edge, modal or beside the page. It has a title, an optional description, content and actions that start with a built-in close button. Base UI's dialog owns focus, Escape and outside presses.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open, for a dialog the application controls with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether a dialog the application doesn't control is open on the first render.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the requested state when the dialog asks to open or close: from the trigger, Escape, an outside press, the close button or a DialogClose. Not called for a dismissal that pending blocks.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the dialog, such as a Button. It reports the dialog it opens, and focus returns to it on close. Omit it for a dialog the application opens with open.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's heading and accessible name, such as “Delete project?”.

props.name: description
props.description: Muted text under the title that describes the dialog to assistive technology too, such as what its action changes.

props.name: children
props.description: The content between the heading and the actions, such as text, fields or a list.

props.name: actions
props.description: The dialog's own actions, after the built-in close button, with the primary action last. They close the dialog only where they are DialogClose or set open to false.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The label of the built-in close button that starts the actions, such as Cancel, or the name of a right panel's close icon button.

props.name: placement
props.description: center for a modal in the middle of the window; top for a modal near the top of the window for search-like tasks, so results grow downward without moving the field; right for a full-height panel at the right edge, with a close icon button beside its title instead of the close button in the actions, which takes the whole width of a narrow window such as a phone's.

props.name: size
props.description: standard, 28 rem wide and 24 rem for a right panel, or wide, 44 rem, for content-heavy dialogs and panels such as tables, comparisons and longer forms. Both narrow to fit the window.

props.name: modal
props.description: true traps focus in the dialog over a backdrop, hides the page from assistive technology, blocks presses on it and locks its scroll. false leaves the page usable beside the dialog, for a side panel that inspects it; it then closes when focus or a press goes outside it, unless disablePointerDismissal.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Keep the dialog open on presses outside it, and a non-modal dialog also when focus moves outside, such as an inspector beside the page it inspects. Escape and the close buttons still close it.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the dialog opens. By default focus moves to the first focusable element inside, such as the first field, or to the dialog itself when opened by touch.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the dialog closes, such as the row that opened it. By default focus returns to the trigger, or to the element that had focus when the dialog opened.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started from the dialog is in progress. Escape, outside presses and the close buttons cannot dismiss it until pending returns to false. The built-in close button is disabled and the dialog reports busy; a DialogClose stays enabled and runs its onClick, so disable it too. Set pending on the action that started the work as well.

DialogClose.description: A button inside a Dialog that closes it after its own onClick, for an action other than the built-in close button, such as Don't save or Done. It takes Button's props and is secondary by default.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The action's name, such as Delete draft, for an icon-only button.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon of an icon-only button.

props.name: variant
props.description: The emphasis: primary for the main action of a view, important for a rare consequential one, secondary and outlined for the rest, destructive for an action that deletes or ends something, text for a link-like action and quiet for an application's chrome, such as a toolbar.

props.name: underline
props.description: Show an underline for the text variant; defaults to false.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as an Add icon.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A decorative icon after the label, such as a ChevronRight for a next step.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started by this button is running: a spinner replaces the content without changing the button's size, and the button reports busy and ignores activation until pending ends.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Show only icon, in a square button that keeps its size; name it with aria-label.

DiffStat.description: The size of a change as one compact pill, such as +12 −3: additions in the success tone and deletions in the danger tone, on a counter badge's quiet fill.

props.name: additions
props.description: Lines or items added, shown as +12 in the success tone.

props.name: deletions
props.description: Lines or items removed, shown as −3 in the danger tone.

props.name: formatLabel
props.description: Full meaning for assistive technology; "12 added lines and 3 removed lines" by default.

DocumentTabs.description: Editor-style closable tabs for open documents; the application renders the active document.

props.name: value
props.description: The active tab, or null.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a tab is clicked or reached with the arrow keys, Home or End.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called from a tab's close button, a middle click and Delete on the focused tab.

props.name: onPin
props.description: Called when a tab is double-clicked, typically to keep a preview tab open.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab strip.

props.name: panelId
props.description: Id of the panel the application renders for the active tab.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of each close button; receives the tab label.

props.name: onCloseAll
props.description: Called from Close all tabs in the strip's context menu. With it, the strip and each tab open that menu on right click, long press, the Menu key and Shift+F10; a tab's menu also offers closing that tab.

props.name: closeAllLabel
props.description: Label of the Close all tabs item.

props.name: contextMenuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the context menu; Tab actions by default.

DropZone.description: A drop target for files that also opens the file picker; the application shows what was chosen.

props.name: label
props.description: What to drop or choose, such as "Drop a logo here, or browse"; the zone's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Which files fit, such as "PNG, JPG or WebP up to 2 MB".

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the upload icon.

props.name: accept
props.description: The file types the zone takes, as in the native accept attribute: MIME types such as image/png, groups such as image/*, and extensions such as .webp. Any file by default.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Take several files at once; otherwise the zone takes the first file.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Receives the dropped or chosen files that the zone takes.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Receives the files that do not match accept, and those after the first without multiple.

props.name: pending
props.description: The application is working on the files: a spinner replaces the icon, the zone reports that it is busy and takes no new files.

props.name: error
props.description: A message linked to the zone, whose outline takes the error color.

props.name: compact
props.description: One row with a small icon instead of the tall area.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits files with a native form under this name: the last files the zone took, until the form resets, or files.

props.name: files
props.description: The files a named zone submits when the application keeps them, such as after a Remove action; they replace the files the zone took, also after the form resets.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of a form the zone belongs to when it is outside of it.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: The native file input that opens the file picker, for example from a Replace button.

props.name: tone
props.description: Error states replace content that failed to load: they show the error icon by default and are announced as an alert. Pair them with a retry action.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's heading level in the page outline; 4 by default. The appearance stays the same.

props.name: align
props.description: `start` (default) for a state inside a card, panel or dialog. `center` for a state that takes the place of a page's or region's content: a larger icon, centred text and action, centred vertically in the height the application gives it.

EnvUILogo.description: Official envUI lockup; inherits its containing theme's text color.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for a meaningful standalone icon. Omit for decoration.

HoverCard.description: Supplementary details that open beside their trigger on hover and keyboard focus, like a link preview.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the card on hover and keyboard focus; it receives the ref.

props.name: children
props.description: The details. Supplementary: never the only place essential information appears.

props.name: side
props.description: bottom (default), top, left or right, or inline-start and inline-end, which follow the text direction.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds the pointer rests on the trigger before the card opens (600); focus opens it at once.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before it closes once the pointer leaves the trigger and the card (300).

props.name: width
props.description: standard (default) about 20 rem wide; wide about 28 rem.

Icon.description: Shared SVG defaults; custom icons may supply their own viewBox and children.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for a meaningful standalone icon. Omit for decoration.

IconButton.description: Shorthand for Button's icon-only mode, using the neutral secondary variant by default.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon, such as Settings.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The action's name, which assistive technology announces, such as Open settings.

props.name: variant
props.description: As Button's; secondary by default.

props.name: pending
props.description: As Button's: a spinner replaces the icon while the work runs.

Kbd.description: A keyboard key, or a combination of keys with keys.

props.name: keys
props.description: Keys pressed together, such as ['Ctrl', 'P']: one key cap each, joined by +, inside an outer `<kbd>`. Without it, the children are one key.

Link.description: A destination inside running text, underlined by default. It is a native link, through the LinkProvider's link component, in the text button's colors.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination: the element is a native link, through the LinkProvider's link component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled button cannot be pressed; a disabled link has no destination, cannot be focused or followed, and reports aria-disabled.

props.name: underline
props.description: Underline the link; true by default, so it stands out from the text around it.

LinkProvider.description: Connects envUI links to the application's router without a router dependency in envUI.

props.name: component
props.description: Renders every envUI destination (Button, Link, NavList.Item, Card, Pager links and menu links with href). It must render an anchor and forward native props and ref, for example a router's link that navigates on the client.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The row opens something through a link or button inside: it reacts to hover, keyboard focus inside it and presses. Mark that link or button `data-row-target` to stretch it over the row.

Markdown.description: CommonMark prose with tables, task lists and other extensions, in envUI typography and code.

props.name: headingOffset
props.description: Add to the document's heading levels; levels are capped at h6.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Receives safe hrefs and native anchor props. Retain a real anchor destination.

props.name: components
props.description: react-markdown component overrides, merged over envUI's own; the application's win. Native props such as id and className reach the element.

props.name: remarkPlugins
props.description: remark plugins that run after envUI's own Markdown extensions.

props.name: rehypePlugins
props.description: rehype plugins, such as heading ids; envUI adds none of its own.

MarkdownEditor.description: Native Markdown source editing, shared formatting history, and optional preview.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Formatting actions; false hides the toolbar. Undo/redo accompany a visible toolbar.

props.name: preview
props.description: Show Write/Preview tabs. Preview uses the same public Markdown renderer.

props.name: onRequestLink
props.description: Optional application picker. Return null to cancel; otherwise return an ordinary link.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, such as Project name; it also names the control for assistive technology.

props.name: hint
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: rows
props.description: The lines the field shows: with fixed sizing, its height in rows, at least 7.5 rem; with content sizing, the lines it starts at and shrinks back to, also under 7.5 rem. Without rows, both start at 7.5 rem.

props.name: variant
props.description: The field's look: outlined, with a thin border; plain, with no border or fill and an underline on hover and focus; or quiet, only its text and start icon at rest, with a soft fill under the pointer and while focused and a placeholder that clears on focus, for a search at the top of a sidebar or a list.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the hint.

props.name: sizing
props.description: How the height follows the text: fixed keeps its height, scrolls and resizes from the bottom edge, by dragging it or with the arrow keys; content grows and shrinks with the text.

Menu.CheckboxItem.description: An independent on/off option; a check mark shows while it is on.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the option is on; a check mark shows while it is.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the item is toggled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The item stays in place, dimmed, but cannot be toggled.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Close the menu after toggling; off by default, so several options can change.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the item's row.

props.name: children
props.description: The item's label, which names it.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint at the end, such as Ctrl+P, shown as Kbd keys and announced as aria-keyshortcuts; a sequence, such as Ctrl+K Ctrl+S, shows its keys without the attribute. The application handles the shortcut itself.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as Settings.

props.name: description
props.description: A second, muted line; announced as the item's description.

Menu.Group.description: A labelled group of related items, with a small heading above its rows.

props.name: label
props.description: Small heading that names the group for assistive technology too.

props.name: children
props.description: Items of the group.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the group.

Menu.Header.description: Non-interactive context at the top of a menu, such as the signed-in account.

props.name: children
props.description: The context, such as the signed-in person's avatar, name and e-mail address.

Menu.Item.description: One action (onClick) or destination (href) in a Menu. Destinations use the LinkProvider's link.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The item is unavailable: it stays in place, dimmed, and reports aria-disabled; its action does not run.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the item's row.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as Settings.

props.name: children
props.description: The item's label, which names it.

props.name: description
props.description: A second, muted line; announced as the item's description.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint at the end, such as Ctrl+P, shown as Kbd keys and announced as aria-keyshortcuts; a sequence, such as Ctrl+K Ctrl+S, shows its keys without the attribute. The application handles the shortcut itself.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End content, such as a Badge or CounterBadge; it is part of the item's name.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination: the item is a link, through the LinkProvider's link component.

props.name: onClick
props.description: The action, run when the item is chosen; the menu then closes.

props.name: target
props.description: Where the destination opens, such as _blank, as on a native link.

props.name: rel
props.description: The destination's relationship to the page, such as noopener, as on a native link.

Menu.RadioGroup.description: One choice among several items; the checked item shows a check mark.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of the checked item, or null for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen item's value.

props.name: children
props.description: Menu.RadioItem elements.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional heading; the group is then labelled like Menu.Group.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the group.

props.name: value
props.description: The value the Menu.RadioGroup reports when this item is chosen.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The item stays in place, dimmed, but cannot be chosen.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Close the menu after choosing.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the item's row.

props.name: children
props.description: The item's label, which names it.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as Settings.

props.name: description
props.description: A second, muted line; announced as the item's description.

Menu.Root.description: A list of actions and destinations that opens from a trigger; keyboard and focus follow the menu pattern.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The control that opens the menu, such as a Button or an AvatarButton; it receives the menu button semantics and ref, so it must accept native props and a ref.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu, such as Account.

props.name: children
props.description: Menu.Header, Menu.Item, Menu.Group, Menu.RadioGroup, Menu.CheckboxItem, Menu.Submenu and Menu.Separator elements.

props.name: side
props.description: The side of the trigger the menu opens on; it flips to the other side where the window has no room.

props.name: align
props.description: How the menu lines up with the trigger along that side.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is open, for a controlled menu; leave it out and the menu opens and closes itself.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled menu starts open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new visibility as the menu opens or closes.

props.name: density
props.description: compact is the desktop dropdown for dense surfaces: a raised popup with 1.75 rem rows, hairline separators and small keys for shortcuts. Submenus open in the same density.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the menu popup.

Menu.Submenu.description: A row that opens a nested menu beside it, on hover or with the keyboard. The submenu opens in the density and theme of its menu, and lines its first row up with the row that opened it.

props.name: label
props.description: The label of the row that opens the submenu, which names the row.

props.name: children
props.description: The submenu's items: Menu.Item, Menu.Group, Menu.Separator and the other parts, nested submenus too.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the submenu; by default the label, when it is a string.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The row stays in place, dimmed, but cannot open its submenu.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility; onOpenChange also suits loading the items as the submenu opens.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled submenu starts open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new visibility as the submenu opens or closes, for example to load its items.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the submenu popup.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as Settings.

props.name: description
props.description: A second, muted line; announced as the item's description.

Menubar.Menu.description: One menu of a Menubar.Root: a compact text trigger and the menu that opens below it. After a command, focus returns to where it was before the menubar took it, as in a desktop application.

props.name: label
props.description: The trigger's text, such as File.

props.name: accessKey
props.description: A letter of the label, such as F for File. With Menubar.Root's accessKeys, holding Alt underlines it and Alt with the letter opens the menu.

props.name: children
props.description: The menu's items: Menu.Item, Menu.Submenu, Menu.Separator and the other menu parts.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu; by default the label, when it is a string.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes, with the element that had focus before the menubar took it.

props.name: density
props.description: compact by default, like the menus of a desktop menubar.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the menu popup.

Menubar.Root.description: An application menubar: a row of compact text buttons that open compact menus, such as File, Edit, View and Help. Once a menu is open, hovering another trigger or pressing ← and → switches to its menu. Opening a menu neither locks scrolling nor shifts the page.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menubar, such as Application menu.

props.name: children
props.description: Menubar.Menu elements.

props.name: accessKeys
props.description: Desktop access keys, off by default: holding Alt underlines each menu's accessKey, Alt with that letter opens the menu, and Alt alone moves focus to the menubar and back. Turn it on for one menubar per window.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every menu of the menubar.

Message.description: One entry of a conversation, such as a chat message or a comment.

props.name: from
props.description: self: written by the person using the app, a compact bubble at the inline end. other: from anyone else, such as an assistant or another participant, full-width content without a bubble.

props.name: author
props.description: Who wrote the message, shown above it.

props.name: meta
props.description: Supporting facts beside the author, such as the time.

props.name: actions
props.description: Small actions below the message, such as copy or retry.

props.name: status
props.description: A message on its way, or one that could not be sent; shown with an icon and text.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Text of the status: Sending or Not sent by default.

MessageList.description: The messages of a conversation in order, as a log: assistive technology politely announces messages added anywhere in it and text that changes. Set busy while a reply streams in or earlier messages load. Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: busy
props.description: Messages are still changing, such as a reply streaming in or earlier messages loading. The log reports aria-busy, so assistive technology can wait for the change to finish instead of announcing every step.

Meter.description: A known quantity within a range, such as used seats or storage.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label and accessible name.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Visible formatted value, such as "2 of 5"; omit to show nothing.

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: Text read by assistive technology instead of the raw number.

NavList.Group.description: Related items under a small heading, inside NavList.Root.

props.name: label
props.description: The group's visible heading, which also names its list.

props.name: children
props.description: The group's NavList.Item elements.

NavList.Item.description: A navigation destination: a link with href, or a button that changes the view.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled button cannot be pressed; a disabled link has no destination, cannot be focused or followed, and reports aria-disabled.

props.name: icon
props.description: Official Material Symbols automatically follow the selected state.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description: Optional alternate content for custom icons when selected.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End content, such as a CounterBadge; icon-only items show a small dot instead.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination: the element is a native link, through the LinkProvider's link component.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Hide the visible label, as in a compact sidebar; a tooltip shows it on hover and focus.

NavList.Root.description: A plain list of navigation items and groups, for a sidebar or anywhere else. Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has more than one; it adds no landmark of its own.

OrganizationSwitcher.description: Shows the active organization and switches between the person's organizations; fits AppShell's context area.

props.name: organizations
props.description: Organizations the signed-in person belongs to, in display order.

props.name: currentOrganizationId
props.description: The active organization, or null before one is chosen.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the id of the organization chosen, unless it is the active one; the application switches and reports progress.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Offers creating an organization at the end of the menu, or as the only action without organizations.

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading inside the menu.

props.name: createLabel
props.description: Label of the create action.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger text while no organization is active.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents opening, for example while a switch is in progress.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the trigger button, or of the create button without organizations.

Pager.Next.description: The destination after this one, with rel="next".

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional decorative icon, placed before the previous link and after the next link.

Pager.Previous.description: The destination before this one, with rel="prev".

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional decorative icon, placed before the previous link and after the next link.

Pager.Root.description: A centered pair of previous and next destinations, from the previous and next props or from Pager.Previous and Pager.Next children; either one can be omitted.

props.name: previous
props.description: The previous destination, as the props of Pager.Previous.

props.name: next
props.description: The next destination, as the props of Pager.Next.

Pagination.description: A compact pager for toolbars: the range of items shown, such as 1–60 of 245, and buttons for the previous and next pages, in a navigation landmark. The application loads the pages.

props.name: page
props.description: The page shown, counted from 1.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: The most items a page shows.

props.name: total
props.description: All items; omit when it is not known, such as for a list read in batches.

props.name: hasNextPage
props.description: Whether a later page exists, for a list without total; true by default.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Receives the page before or after the current one when a button is pressed.

props.name: pending
props.description: A page is loading: the button pressed shows a spinner, and both wait.

props.name: hideWhenSinglePage
props.description: Renders nothing while all items fit on one page.

props.name: formatRange
props.description: Text for the range, such as "1–60 of 245", for example in another language.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Name and tooltip of the previous button; Previous page by default.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Name and tooltip of the next button; Next page by default.

props.name: variant
props.description: As IconButton; secondary by default.

props.name: size
props.description: standard (default) takes the surrounding density; compact gives 2 rem buttons anywhere.

PanelDock.description: Panels docked to the bottom inline-end edge of a region, beside the page, for items people work on alongside it, such as drafts and conversations: open panels side by side, one maximized panel filling the region, and minimized panels as chips. A panel's content stays mounted through every change of mode and order.

props.name: panels
props.description: The panels in order; open panels sit side by side and chips follow in the same order.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders a panel's content, such as a PanelDockHeader above the panel's body.

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Called with the mode a panel asks for, from its window controls and its chip, and from the dock itself with overflow="minimize".

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called from a panel's close control and its chip's close button.

props.name: onActivate
props.description: Called when people press or focus inside a panel that is not active, and when its chip brings it back.

props.name: onHeightChange
props.description: Called with a panel's new height in pixels when a drag on its top edge ends, and on each key press there.

props.name: stackBelow
props.description: A width, 40rem by default, or a number of pixels, such as 600 or "600": while the dock itself is narrower, one panel at a time fills it and the others wait as chips. The dock then has data-stacked.

props.name: onStackedChange
props.description: Called with true when the dock stacks and with false when its panels sit side by side.

props.name: overflow
props.description: What the dock does when its open panels cannot all sit side by side at their minimum widths: scroll (default) scrolls the row sideways; minimize asks onModeChange to minimize the least recently active open panel, one at a time, until the rest fit, and to open it again once the region widens and it fits. It never asks for the active panel, the newest one or the one that holds focus, so never for a panel alone in the row, and where those cannot fit by themselves the row scrolls instead.

props.name: minimizedLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the list of chips, which holds minimized panels and the panels a stacked dock leaves out; Hidden panels by default.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a chip's button that shows its panel, from the chip's text: Show and the text by default. A function, as each chip names its own panel; PanelDockControls takes plain strings.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a chip's close button, from the chip's text: Close and the text by default.

props.name: resizeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a panel's resize handle, from its title: Resize and the title by default.

PanelDockControls.description: Minimize, Maximize or Restore, and Close for the panel around it, as compact icon buttons with tooltips. A stacked dock already fills the region, so its panels leave out Maximize.

props.name: minimizeLabel
props.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that minimizes the panel; Minimize by default.

props.name: maximizeLabel
props.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that maximizes the panel; Maximize by default.

props.name: restoreLabel
props.description: The same for a maximized panel, which returns it to the row; Restore by default.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that closes the panel; Close by default.

PanelDockHeader.description: The header of a docked panel. It sticks to the top of the panel while its content scrolls: the title and its metadata at the start, the application's actions and the window controls at the end, compact like a title bar's.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's title, as a heading.

props.name: meta
props.description: Supporting text below the title, such as who changed it last.

props.name: actions
props.description: The application's own actions before the window controls, such as Edit and a menu of more.

props.name: controls
props.description: The window controls; PanelDockControls inside a PanelDock by default, null for none.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's heading level in the page outline; 2 by default. The appearance stays the same.

props.name: children
props.description: Content below the title row that stays with the header, such as Tabs.

Popover.description: A floating panel opened from a trigger, for details or a small form beside the control.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The control that opens the popover; it receives the expanded state and ref.

props.name: title
props.description: A heading that also names the popover.

props.name: children
props.description: Content, or a function that receives close for actions inside the popover.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no title.

props.name: width
props.description: standard (default) about 20 rem wide; wide about 28 rem.

Progress.description: Completion of a task; pass value null while the amount of work is unknown.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label and accessible name.

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: Text read by assistive technology instead of the raw number.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Visible formatted value, such as "2 of 5"; omit to show nothing.

Rating.description: A read-only rating: stars filled to the value in half steps, in the warning tone.

props.name: value
props.description: The rating, from 0 to max; it shows in half-star steps.

props.name: max
props.description: How many stars; 5 by default.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the number before the stars, such as 4.5.

props.name: formatLabel
props.description: The accessible name; "4.5 out of 5 stars" by default.

RelativeTime.description: A moment in a time element as text relative to now, such as "3 hours ago", with the date and time in a tooltip. One shared clock keeps every RelativeTime on the page current.

props.name: value
props.description: The moment to describe.

props.name: now
props.description: A fixed moment to compare with, for tests and server rendering; the text then stays as it is. Without it, or with an invalid one, the text follows the current time.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show the date and time in a tooltip on hover; true by default. Inside an application's own Tooltip, that one describes the time instead.

props.name: locale
props.description: Language of the text, such as "en-GB" or "de"; the runtime's default by default.

props.name: format
props.description: long "3 hours ago" (default), short "3 hr. ago" or narrow "3h ago".

props.name: nowLabel
props.description: Text for a moment less than 45 seconds away: "just now" for past moments in English, "now" for coming ones, and the locale's own word for now in other languages.

RichText.description: Static, SSR-capable view using exactly the editor's Tiptap schema and Markdown parser.

props.name: extensions
props.description: Keep this array stable; extensions must implement Markdown parsing and serialization.

props.name: renderReference
props.type: (reference: RichTextReference, context: { readOnly: boolean; selected: boolean }) => ReactNode

RichTextEditor.description: Markdown IO with Tiptap owning document editing, history, and selection.

props.name: slashCommands
props.description: true enables standard block commands; an array adds application commands to them.

props.name: onRequestLink
props.description: For selections the URL marks existing content; label is used only for new links at the caret.

props.name: onUpload
props.type: (file: File, request: { signal: AbortSignal }) => RichTextAttachment | null | Promise<RichTextAttachment | null>

props.name: extensions
props.description: Keep this array stable; extensions must implement Markdown parsing and serialization.

props.name: renderReference
props.type: (reference: RichTextReference, context: { readOnly: boolean; selected: boolean }) => ReactNode

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, such as Project name; it also names the control for assistive technology.

props.name: hint
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the hint.

props.name: variant
props.description: The field's look: outlined, with a thin border; plain, with no border or fill and an underline on hover and focus; or quiet, only its text and start icon at rest, with a soft fill under the pointer and while focused and a placeholder that clears on focus, for a search at the top of a sidebar or a list.

SearchField.description: A search input with a search icon and, while it has a query, a clear button; Esc also clears. Compact by default, to sit beside buttons.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's accessible name, such as Search members. It shows as a floating label only when the field is not compact or sets showLabel; otherwise a placeholder gives the visible guidance.

props.name: value
props.description: The query of a controlled field; update it from onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The query an uncontrolled field starts with.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the next query as people type, and an empty string when the clear button or Esc clears it.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: The accessible name and tooltip of the clear button, in the application's language.

props.name: hint
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: compact
props.description: Take the shared control height and a pill shape, to sit beside buttons in a toolbar. The label is hidden unless showLabel is set; it still names the field for assistive technology, and a placeholder gives the visible guidance.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Short, non-interactive text before the value, such as the start of an address. It is not part of the value; it shows once the field has focus or a value and is read after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: The field's look: outlined, with a thin border; plain, with no border or fill and an underline on hover and focus; or quiet, only its text and start icon at rest, with a soft fill under the pointer and while focused and a placeholder that clears on focus, for a search at the top of a sidebar or a list.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the hint.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label in the field, where it rests while the field is empty and floats into the outline while the field has focus or a value. Compact fields hide it unless this is set.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Short, non-interactive text after the value, such as a unit. It is not part of the value; it shows once the field has focus or a value and is read after the label.

SegmentedControl.description: One choice among a few options on a pill rail; the chosen segment takes the primary colors.

props.name: options
props.description: Two to five options.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the group.

props.name: size
props.description: standard (default) matches buttons; compact matches compact fields and toolbars.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the available width, split evenly between the options; a label too long for its share is cut short with an ellipsis and shows whole in a tooltip. Without it the control is as wide as its options, and scrolls in a container too narrow for them.

Select.description: A single selection with native form participation and a themed popup.

props.name: variant
props.description: The trigger's Button style, to suit its surroundings: secondary (default) for the page canvas, outlined for panes, dialogs, rows and toolbars.

props.name: density
props.description: compact suits dense desktop surfaces: a compact trigger and the compact menu's popup, where a check mark shows the selected option.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, such as Project name; it also names the control for assistive technology.

props.name: hint
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the hint.

Slider.description: A value in a range, chosen by dragging a thumb along a track or with the keyboard.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label and the slider's accessible name.

props.name: hint
props.description: Guidance below the slider, linked to it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when the slider owns it; min by default.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the value while it changes, by dragging, pressing the track or with the keyboard.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Receives the value once a change is complete, such as when the thumb is released.

props.name: min
props.description: 0 by default.

props.name: max
props.description: 100 by default.

props.name: step
props.description: The values between min and max that the slider can take; 1 by default.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The change of Page Up, Page Down and arrow keys with Shift; a tenth of the range by default.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: The value as people read and hear it, such as (value) => `${value}%`.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the value with a form under this name.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of a form the slider belongs to when it is outside of it.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: The native range input, for example to focus it.

Spinner.description: Ongoing work of unknown length in a small area, such as a button or a panel that is updating.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Omit it when a busy control or region already announces the work.

props.name: size
props.description: small 1 rem (inside controls), standard 1.5 rem (default) or large 3 rem.

Stack.description: Vertical composition. The parent owns spacing between its direct children.

props.name: render
props.description: Compose layout onto another component without adding a wrapper.

Stat.Group.description: Stats on one surface, a pane by default, in as many even columns as fit; they wrap as space runs out. Use the row tone for a group on a pane. A group named with aria-label or aria-labelledby is exposed as a group, so assistive technology announces the name.

props.name: padding
props.description: Omit for responsive padding; 0 removes padding.

Stat.Root.description: A labelled key figure for a dashboard, with an optional trend and detail.

props.name: label
props.description: What the figure measures, such as Active projects.

props.name: value
props.description: The figure, such as a formatted number or an AnimatedNumber.

props.name: detail
props.description: A muted line below, such as the period: Last 30 days.

props.name: trend
props.description: The change since an earlier period, shown with an icon and text in its tone.
